target_customer: Companies whose employees build internal apps; later positioned as AI agents for business teams
problem: Vibe coding tools are hard to roll out internally because of data connections, SSO sprawl and security risk. Vybe offers prebuilt integrations, SSO and AI tools so anyone can build internal apps.
product_category: AI internal app builder, evolving into an AI agent platform

founders.name: Quang Hoang
previous_startups: Plato (YC W16, acquired by Coda, raised 23M, 5M ARR)
founders.background_notes: Led Product and go to market for Coda Solutions per the YC page.

founders.name: Fabien Devos
founders.background_notes: Director of Engineering at Wealthfront per the YC page; the YC long description says ex-SWE at Meta.

competitors.name: Lovable, Replit, Bolt
competitors.traction_then: YC description states people love them but they are hard to roll out inside companies

technical_complexity.rationale: Building secure integrations, SSO and data access controls around AI code generation is substantial but uses standard components.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and SSO add stickiness, but Retool, Superblocks and the general builders can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Retool launched an AI app builder and enterprise AppGen features per its own blog; Vybe itself later broadened toward agents.

market_need_then: Companies used spreadsheets, rigid SaaS and no-code tools for internal needs while vibe coding spread in 2025; company argues security and data access block internal rollout.

branding.domain_note: Uses vybe.build, not an exact vybe.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain pitch as Lovable for internal apps

brand_strength.rationale: Startup trade press and a published pitch deck got attention; the name is shared with many unrelated brands.

pivots.to: AI agents that use company tools and handle recurring work
pivots.why: Per a RuntimeWire profile the pitch broadened; date and reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Vybe raised a 10M seed on 2025-12-10 led by First Round, with YC, Orange Collective, Pelion and Pioneer Fund, backed by repeat YC founders with a prior Coda exit. The vibe coding wave and founder track record drove the raise. The product has broadened toward agents, and Retool and general builders are strong competitors. Still active as of mid 2026.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog dated 2025-12-10 and press. Other dates seen (February 2025, 2026-02) conflict and are not used. StartupHub lists 3M total and another source 10.5M; unverified. Founder education not found. Fabien's employer conflicts slightly (Wealthfront director per YC page, Meta per long description); both Wealthfront and Facebook recorded. Competition list rests on the YC page rather than a dated third party.
